headline: Source: Steelers' Roman Wilson expected to miss multiple weeks
summary: Roman Wilson will miss multiple weeks because of a finger injury, a source told ESPN, joining the growing list of injured Steelers receivers.

headline: QB Tyler Huntley leads Ravens to comeback OT win vs. Falcons
summary: With Lamar Jackson still out, Tyler Huntley backed up the Ravens' faith in him by leading them to a 30-23 overtime win against the Falcons, during which Huntley was 11-for-11 passing for 80 yards on the final two drives.

headline: Lions' Tom Kennedy, Devin White will both miss time with injuries suffered Sunday
summary: The Lions lost linebacker Devin White and receiver/returner Tom Kennedy to injuries on Sunday in Arizona, and both appear likely to miss some time, but not the entire season.
